english.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a verbal account or portrayal of something.
This is the all-purpose noun for a verbal portrayal or the act of presenting something in words; use 畫 for a physical image.

examples.english: This report gives a detailed description of what happened in the accident.
examples.traditional: 呢份報告對事故經過有詳細描述。
examples.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 deoi3 si6 gu3 ging1 gwo3 jau5 coeng4 sai3 miu4 seot6

examples.english: The depiction of that old man in the passage is very vivid.
examples.traditional: 呢段文字對嗰位老人嘅描述好傳神。
examples.jyutping: ne1 dyun6 man4 zi6 deoi3 go2 wai6 lou5 jan4 ge3 miu4 seot6 hou2 cyun4 san4
